steps.eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const root = document.querySelector('[data-scroll-root="true"]'); if (!root) throw new Error('缺少滚动容器'); root.scrollTop = 1800; await sleep(500); const saved = Math.round(root.scrollTop); if (Math.abs(saved - 1800) > 4) throw new Error('设置页滚不到 1800：' + saved); return { saved }; })()
